metadata.displayName: Storage account should use a private link connection
metadata.description: Private links enforce secure communication by providing private connectivity to the storage account.
metadata.remediationDescription: To add a private endpoint connection to your storage account: 1. Go to your storage account in the Azure portal. 2. Select Networking. 3. Select Private endpoint connections. 4. Select + Private endpoint.

properties.displayName: Virtual machines should encrypt temp disks, caches, and data flows

status.description: Azure Disk Encryption is not enabled on the virtual machine.

metadata.displayName: Virtual machines should encrypt temp disks, caches, and data flows
metadata.description: By default, a virtual machine's OS and data disks are encrypted at rest using platform-managed keys. Temp disks and data caches aren't encrypted, and data isn't encrypted when flowing between compute and storage resources.
metadata.remediationDescription: To enable disk encryption on your virtual machine: 1. Go to the Azure portal. 2. Select the virtual machine. 3. Under Settings, select Disks. 4. Enable encryption.
